title: U.S. Inflation Accelerates in August: Energy Prices Drive Headline CPI
discussion_signal: The post distinguishes headline CPI acceleration from more moderate core inflation and highlights energy, gasoline, shelter, food, and medical-care components. It shows how a statistical release is translated into competing household-cost and policy narratives.
linked_research_question: How do price changes become different lived burdens and public narratives across household spending categories?
limits: The post is an individual interpretation of BLS data
Aggregate CPI does not represent every household's consumption basket
Narrative emphasis on energy does not establish distributional impact
